Density measurement test on SS soil; apparatus: method of test suggested by D. M. Burmister (ASTM Procedures for Testing Soils 1964 pp. 175-177). Recorded: unit weight vs relative density (average and 95% confidence limits).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 32 of the 38 points, and 3 are still under review. They have not yet been checked by a person. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, control, rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![unit weight (minimum at Dr 0 to maximum at Dr 1.0) against relative density, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-dens-fa-27.png){.lightbox}

Peak unit weight (minimum at Dr 0 to maximum at Dr 1.0) 1.773e+04 N/m^3 at 0.9 relative density; 1.803e+04 N/m^3 at 1, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-dens-fa-27/observations.csv) (38 points: 0 plotted symbols, 33 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: unit weight (minimum at Dr 0 to maximum at Dr 1.0) in N/m^3 against relative density (dimensionless); the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-dens-fa-27/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 0.003036 in relative density, 27.15 N/m^3 in unit weight (0.2 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 32 of the 38 points; 3 are still under review (hollow in the plot) and 3 were settled against the scan. [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fa-27).
